history.title: 🇻🇳 First Indochina War
history.description: France attempts to reestablish colonial control. Ho Chi Minh's Viet Minh wage guerrilla war.
history.historicalContext: Eight-year war drains French treasury. Ends at Dien Bien Phu 1954.

deploymentTrigger.description: French military deployment to Southeast Asia triggers colonial war

France.outcome: Fight for 8 years. Massive costs. Defeated at Dien Bien Phu.
Accept decolonization. Save resources. Focus on Europe.

USA.outcome: Pay 80% of costs! They still lose. Sets you up to inherit war.
Position yourself as anti-colonial. Helps in Asia.

India.outcome: Nehru champions anti-colonialism. Leader of non-aligned.

India has just gained independence and needs trade partners. Publicly neutral, privately sympathetic to Ho Chi Minh. France continues purchasing Indian goods. But the non-aligned movement loses a champion.

USSR.outcome: Soviet weapons help Ho Chi Minh. Another communist victory in Asia.
Support decolonization publicly without major commitment. Focus resources on Europe.

history.title: 🇮🇳 India Partition Crisis
history.description: India gains independence but partition sparks massive violence. 1-2 million dead, 15 million displaced.
history.historicalContext: Britain hastily partitions India along religious lines. Unprecedented communal violence erupts.

deploymentTrigger.description: Military tensions in South Asia accelerate the partition crisis

India.outcome: You save millions but economy suffers massive strain.
Army prevents worst violence in cities but can't be everywhere.

UK.text: 💷 Provide Financial Aid to Both Nations
UK.outcome: You try to make amends. Both nations appreciate gesture.
Maximum chaos. Your reputation in tatters.

history.title: 🚨 Berlin Blockade Crisis
history.description: USSR blocks all ground routes to West Berlin. Western powers must respond.
history.historicalContext: Stalin blocks rail and road access. City can only be supplied by air.

deploymentTrigger.description: Massive Soviet deployment to Eastern Europe triggers the Berlin Blockade

USA.outcome: Supply Berlin for 11 months. Stalin backs down. Western resolve proven.

UK.outcome: British RAF joins operation. Demonstrates Western unity.
Negotiate with Soviets while airlift operates. Moderate success.

France.outcome: French bases critical for supply routes. Strengthens Western ties.
Allow airlift but avoid military commitment. Domestic criticism.

USSR.outcome: If West succeeds with airlift, you lose face.

history.triggerReason: Massive Soviet deployment to Eastern Europe triggers the Berlin Blockade

history.title: 💰 Marshall Plan Announced
history.description: USA offers $13 billion to rebuild Western Europe.
history.historicalContext: Marshall proposes massive aid. Designed to counter Soviet influence.

deploymentTrigger.description: American military presence in Western Europe prompts Marshall Plan to secure economic stability

USA.outcome: Western Europe recovers. Win Cold War economically.
Enough to prevent European collapse but not enough for full recovery. Congress is happier. Europe recovers slowly — some nations turn to Soviet trade to fill the gap. Containment is partial.

UK.text: 🏛️ Accept Aid but Protect Imperial Preference
UK.outcome: Accept aid but insist on preserving Commonwealth trade preferences. Less American money flows in, but Britain keeps its trade bloc intact. Washington is irritated by British exceptionalism.

France.text: 🇫🇷 Accept Aid but Assert French Economic Sovereignty
France.outcome: Accept aid on French terms — direct it toward French industrial planning (Monnet Plan) rather than American free-market prescriptions. Less total aid received but greater national control. Seeds of Gaullist independence.

USSR.outcome: Iron Curtain descends. East-West split solidifies. Eastern European nations resent being cut off from Western aid.
Create COMECON to rival Marshall Plan. Subsidize Eastern European economies with Soviet resources. Costly but prevents satellites from looking westward. The socialist economic bloc takes shape.

history.title: 🌾 Global Commodity Price Surge
history.description: Post-war food shortages drive grain and beef prices to record highs. Argentina dominates global food exports.
history.historicalContext: Europe is starving. Argentina and USA are the only major food exporters. Argentina uses IAPI to control prices.

Argentina.outcome: Huge profits! But Europe resents you. USA accuses Argentina of profiteering.
Good profits AND goodwill. Spain especially grateful.

Argentina.text: 🍞 Provide Food Aid to Devastated Nations
Argentina.outcome: Evita's charitable image extended to foreign policy. Huge popularity.

USA.outcome: Undercut Argentina. Europe grateful but American farmers unhappy.
Profits flow. But accused of not helping starving Europeans.

UK.outcome: Marshall Plan provides food. More dependent on USA.

France.outcome: Wine and culture for beef and grain. Mutual respect.

Intensify food production in North Africa and Indochina. Reduce dependency on Argentine imports. Colonial subjects bear the cost — forced labor quotas increase. Effective but morally costly, and fuels independence movements.

India.outcome: Developing nations should control their resources! Third World unity.

India has vast farmland. Redirect some domestic production to export at prices below Argentina's. European buyers welcome the competition. Indian farmers earn more, but domestic food security tightens.

history.title: 🇰🇷 Korean War Erupts
history.description: North Korea invades South. UN calls for defense. Major test of containment.
history.historicalContext: Stalin approved invasion. Truman sees this as test of containment.

deploymentTrigger.description: Soviet and Chinese military buildup in East Asia leads to Korean War

USA.outcome: Push to 38th parallel. If advance to China border, China intervenes!
Catastrophic for credibility. Every ally panics.

UK.outcome: Push to 38th parallel. If advance to China border, China intervenes!
Catastrophic for credibility. Every ally panics.

China.text: 🇨🇳 Enter War if USA Approaches Border
China.outcome: Human wave attacks. Push USA back. Massive casualties but prove China major power.

Mass troops at the Yalu but don't cross. If USA stays south of the 38th parallel, China stays out. Avoid catastrophic casualties but appear weak to Moscow. North Korea may fall. Mao's prestige within the Communist world suffers — but the Chinese economy is spared.

India.text: 📢 Condemn North Korean Aggression at UN
India.outcome: Side with the Western position at the UN Security Council. Gain American goodwill and trade access, but alienate the Soviet bloc and damage India's non-aligned credentials. Nehru faces domestic criticism from the left.

Argentina.outcome: Distant conflict. Focus on domestic issues.

Argentina.text: 🌾 Sell Food and Supplies to UN Forces
Argentina.outcome: War means hungry armies. Argentine beef and grain flow to UN supply lines at premium prices. Profitable neutrality — everyone's friend, nobody's ally. Perón's Third Position in action.

USSR.text: 🚩 Provide Weapons and Advisors to North Korea
USSR.outcome: Soviet MiGs and tanks help North Korea. Risk of direct confrontation with USA.
Provide some aid while maintaining deniability. Let China take the lead.

France.outcome: Show solidarity with allies while preserving forces for Indochina.
Already fighting in Vietnam. Cannot commit to Korea. Allies understand... mostly.

history.title: 🌵 Argentine Drought Crisis
history.description: Severe drought devastates Argentine grain production. The economic miracle falters.
history.historicalContext: After years of abundance, nature strikes back. Grain exports plummet. Government reserves depleted.

Argentina.outcome: Cut spending. Unions furious. Peronist base cracks.
Compromise Third Position principles. IMF conditions hurt sovereignty.
Print money to fund programs. Workers love you. Inflation soars.

USA.outcome: Extend olive branch. Perón reluctantly accepts. Relations improve.
Perón refuses. 'We would rather starve!' Latin America rallies to Argentina.

UK.text: 🍞 Return the Favor — Send Food to Argentina
UK.outcome: Remember when Argentina fed us? Time to repay. Relations healed.

UK.text: 📊 Use Argentine Weakness to Renegotiate Trade Terms
UK.outcome: Argentina is desperate — demand better terms on beef and grain contracts. Short-term profits, but Perón will remember this betrayal. Future Anglo-Argentine trade suffers.
